topic: A person's online friend turns out to live in the same city
text: Well, I never. It turns out the person I’ve been chatting with online for months, pouring my heart out over late-night messages and weekend exchanges, actually lives in the very same city. We’ve been sharing our deepest thoughts and dreams, supporting each other through thick and thin, all while I’ve been under the impression they were oceans away. The universe has a peculiar sense of humor, doesn’t it? Now, it seems, there’s a whole new layer to our friendship. I suppose it’s time to meet in person, though the idea brings a mix of intrigue and a sense of stepping into the unknown. Strangers, neighbors, now friends—what a twisted path this is.
